verdict.rationale: Proa documents typed Rust components with compile-time-checked props that are vendored into your repo and meant to be composed into larger UIs (proa-docs-7, proa-docs-32, proa-docs-6). Components can own local reactive state: adding signals and event handlers turns a component into a hydrated island with its own seed state and a small JS module (proa-gh-3, proa-docs-16). Missing for 10: detailed docs on local state scoping and lifecycle, explicit guidance on nesting and composing stateful components or passing state between them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
